name: lane_cutover_registry_20261109
comment: ANCHOR: LANE_CUTOVER_REGISTRY_20261109 — retiring a lane's cron line is the second step of the
cutover ladder, not the third. Lanes left on scheduler.kind cron after the retire are excused a
RUN_SKIPPED_LOCK by a twin that no longer exists: 2026-11-09 four lanes were held by their own
retired cron line at their own slot. The four now carry the dispatcher row and a cutover health
contract; the baseline of lanes still on cron may only shrink. Synthetic crontab, real registry.
